question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-data boundaries must those widgets follow?
rationale: The feature is plausible and aligned with dashboard ergonomics, but it exposes logs and command output in a new always-available UI surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding/security choices.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, finish or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow only a focused read-only widget using existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding generic command execution or new stream bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Binding Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, finish or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/command binding security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current plugin-tab seam and have the strongest merged-history signal across the existing Control UI plugin-tab and log-tail boundary.
